focus: Verify thread identity, message ordering, replay determinism, acknowledgement boundaries, and secure handoff continuity.
Reject stale, duplicated, reordered, cross-thread, or ambiguously acknowledged records before they influence a decision.
Attack truncation, partial delivery, confused-deputy behavior, hidden substitution, and false end-to-end completion.
Keep transport, observation, judgment, authorization, execution, and merge as separate capabilities.
Require exact protocol pins, deterministic replay, bounded recovery evidence, and fail-closed behavior on missing records.
